strengths: Dramatic visual zoom-out reveal creates immediate curiosity in the first seconds.
Easily translates to King Robert lying dramatically helpless on the castle floor amidst a funny dilemma.
concerns: Slow pacing of the original trend needs to be accelerated to fit fast-paced user acquisition standards.
adaptation_idea: Start with a close-up of King Robert lying dramatically defeated on the floor, then zoom out to reveal he is surrounded by castle debris and fire, triggering a prompt for the player to solve a puzzle and rescue him.
